size_measurement_note: Byte and character sizes are structural proxies, not actual model tokens or cost. Per-field sizes use canonical UTF-8 JSON (sorted keys, no optional spaces, ensure_ascii=False). Raw user-context text sizes are also reported. Portable image references are not the full transmitted multimodal payload.
metadata_count_note: Recursive key occurrence differences include descendants of omitted parent subtrees; they are not disjoint byte or token attribution.
operation_memory_note: Projected zero operation_count values for stage-program catalogues are existing official projection behavior, not an estimate of executable stage count.

provider_observed_prompt_tokens.note: Provider prompt_tokens are observed separately from replay-summary.json, counted once per recorded transport attempt. Missing usage is unknown, not zero. Exact token savings cannot be attributed to a context field without new API ablations; no field token or cost estimates are made.
